submissions.projectTitle: Student Engagement Series of Events for Fall 2026- Cafecito with the Counselor
submissions.projectDescription:
Action Plan: "Cafecito with the Counselor"-  ENGAGEMENT EVENTS SERIES
Objective: To increase CalWORKs student belonging and persistence through informal, high-touch community building.
The implementation of student engagement events will further support our CalWORKs students and increase their sense of belonging on campus. I would like to propose launching a monthly "Cafecito with the Counselor" event. 
The goal of this initiative is to provide an informal, welcoming space where students can drop in, ask quick questions, and build community with one another. I believe this "high-touch" approach will improve student rapport and help us identify potential barriers to their success earlier in the semester.
Traditional 30-minute appointments may feel formal or intimidating for students navigating high-stress transitions. When students develop a sense of belonging, counselors and students together can further identify academic or personal barriers.
By establishing a "high-touch," informal community space, this action plan directly addresses SDCCE’s Equity priorities and Counseling priorities. This approach mirrors the "Community Building Events" and "Goal-Oriented Counseling" strategies recommended by the Counselor Institute to boost morale and persistence
submissions.measurableOutcomes:
Effectiveness will be measured through both qualitative and quantitative data:
Attendance Tracking: Using SARS and a spreadsheet to track "in-reach" and "outreach" efficiency.
Student Feedback: Surveys focusing on "sense of belonging" and "preferred contact methods".
Gap Analysis: Comparing survey data against current formal structures to see if "high-touch" needs are being met.

submissions.projectDescription:
My goal is to develop a cohesive, data-informed LGBTQIA+ student support framework that strengthens outreach, improves service coordination, enhances belonging, and updates the program identity across SDCCE. This project integrates four core components:

Outreach & Services Roadmap
Warm Handoff & Referral System
Student Needs & Trends Data Dashboard
Program Title Review & Renaming Process
submissions.measurableOutcomes:
1. Outreach & Services Roadmap (Fall + Spring)
Goal: Build a structured, semester-long plan that increases visibility, access, and engagement for LGBTQIA+ students by the beginning of fall semester. 
Deliverables:
- Outreach calendar
- Messaging templates
- Workshop/event plan
- Community partner directory

2. Warm Handoff & Referral System
Goal: Reduce student drop-off between referral → service by creating a consistent, trauma-informed process by fall semester.
Deliverables:
- Referral workflow map
- Warm handoff protocol
- Staff quick guide

3. Student Needs & Trends Data Dashboard
Goal: Use real data to guide programming, outreach, and resource allocation by fall semester.
Deliverables:
- Document summarizing key trends
- Recommendations for programming for 26-27

4. Program Title Review & Renaming Process
Goal: Evaluate whether the current “LGBTQIA+ Program” title should be updated to a name that is more accessible, memorable, and reflective of student identity and community culture. By fall semester. 

Deliverables
- A brief student feedback survey (digital + in-person)
- Focus group or listening session notes (optional)
- Analysis of naming trends across CCCs and universities
- A shortlist of 2–4 recommended program names
